testScope: New authored scenario families and layout-theme pool. Shared generator/table components mean this is not an independent real-world or unseen-issuer test. Paired captures are not independent documents.
publicRegressionScope: The previously inspected v0.1 public test is regression only, not fresh holdout.
limitations: All new visual documents are synthetic; no new real user documents or screenshots were used.
Public source/class confounding persists in the inherited corpus.
The held-out synthetic scenarios share common rendering components with training; this can inflate performance.
Only three broad labels are trained, not 36 reliable fine-grained types.
Scan OCR is local macOS training infrastructure; the extension still lacks general scan OCR.
Scores are uncalibrated and cannot be called probability of correctness.
Previously viewed challenge/demo packs were not added to training or treated as fresh tests.
